<br>
Privacy settings in most browsers allow you to prevent your browser from accepting some or all cookies, notify you when it receives a new cookie, or disable cookies altogether. <br>

Also, if you delete or clear your cookies, or change your web browser, you will need to reset your cookie preferences.
<br>
<br>
